## Houston 1.0.10

### What's new

- **Teams are out of beta.** From Friday, October 23, personal and team spaces work the same way, so you can invite people to any space. A short message explains the change when you open Houston.
- **Pick your free organization.** Each account keeps one free organization. If you own more than one, a short picker lets you choose which one stays free. If you have a subscription, you also pick which organization it pays for. You can change both later in Settings > Billing.

### Fixes and polish

- Security updates and more reliability improvements under the hood.

### Before you upgrade

- Quit Houston before installing. macOS doesn't always replace a running app. If in doubt, delete Houston from Applications and drag the new copy in.
